breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the contradictory 'rigid in shear' assumption entirely. It proceeds directly to compute a nonzero shear strain (γ_avg = 7.657×10^-5) and a nonzero relative lateral displacement (Δ = 0.001531 mm), consistent with the ground truth prompt which also omits the rigid-in-shear clause.
